{{Quote|Good evening, ''R5-Q3''. What's the special tonight?''"<br />"''Bleep-bleep-vroop!''"<br />"''You almost ''read my mind''&hellip;|[[Arlain Zee]] and R5-Q3|<ref name="Lockdown (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.47|Lockdown (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''R5-Q3''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who was owned by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Arlain Zee]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Zee was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] alongside various other captured [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tempestuous]]''. Posing as a Republic serving [[Droid/Legends|droid]], R5-Q3 entered Zee's cell to deliver him a meal and deactivated the cell's [[Particle shield/Legends|force field]], allowing Zee to escape. The droid then proceeded to free the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]] and several other bounty hunters. While the other prisoners were quickly [[Riot aboard the Tempestuous|recaptured]], Zee was successful at fleeing the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], escaping by [[Mind uploading|downloading]] his consciousness into R5-Q3.
